transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been getting stuck on these thoughts at work. Like I might’ve missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or sent the wrong version to a client. Even when I check and it seems fine, it kind of keeps coming back in my head.
Do you find yourself doing anything over and over to try to make these thoughts go away?

Yeah… a bit. Before I send something, I’ll open the file again, compare the layers, re-save it… sometimes I kind of run through the design choices in my head one more time. It’s not like it takes the whole day, but it does slow me down. Makes me feel less… free with the work, I guess.
Do you experience any physical sensations, like a racing heart or sweating, when these thoughts come up?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I get tense, but I haven’t really noticed sweating or my heart racing or anything like that.
Do you find yourself repeating these checking behaviors or similar ones when you're not working?

Not really outside of work… or at least I don’t notice it as much. It’s mostly before I submit something — I’ll reopen the file, check the layers, save it again, and sort of go through the choices in my head. It doesn’t take over everything, but it slows me down.
Do you feel like these thoughts and checking behaviors are affecting your overall quality of life or relationships?

A little, yeah. I mean, I’m still getting the work done, but I’ve started missing some internal deadlines. And I think I’m playing it safer with designs than I used to… because I’m worried I’ll miss something and it’ll hurt my chances of moving up, like toward a creative director role.
Would you say these thoughts about potential mistakes at work are unwanted, or are they something you're intentionally thinking about?

They feel unwanted, mostly. I don’t sit down trying to think about it. It’s more like… I’ll know the layout is probably fine, but then this nagging thought comes back that maybe I missed some tiny mistake or sent the wrong version, and my mind just circles back to it.
Do you feel like these thoughts and checking behaviors are causing you a lot of distress?

Yeah… somewhat. I wouldn’t say it’s unbearable, but it does bother me. I can see the layout is probably fine, and then I still get that thought that I missed some tiny thing or sent the wrong version, and it just keeps coming back.
Are these thoughts and behaviors affecting your relationships with friends or family?
Not really… I haven’t noticed it affecting friends or family much. It’s more something I keep to myself, I guess.
Would you say these thoughts about mistakes at work pop into your head when you're not trying to think about them?

Yes… they just pop up. I’m not trying to think about it, but I’ll be doing something else and suddenly I’m wondering if I missed a small mistake in a layout or sent the wrong file. Then it kind of loops back around.
Do you feel like these thoughts about potential mistakes are in line with your own beliefs and values?

I guess… not really. I mean, I do care about doing good work and not sending the wrong thing, but the way it keeps circling back feels kind of excessive. Even when I can see the layout is probably fine, my mind still gets stuck on some tiny possible mistake.
Would you say these thoughts about mistakes at work ever feel like they're forcing their way into your mind?

Yes… kind of. It’s like they push in even when I’m trying to focus on something else. I’ll know the layout is probably fine, but then my mind goes back to, like, what if I missed one small thing or sent the wrong version.
Do you feel like these thoughts about potential mistakes are a part of yourself or something that is being imposed on you?

It feels like it’s coming from me, I guess… because it’s about my work and I do care about getting things right. But at the same time, it feels kind of imposed, like I don’t want to keep thinking about whether I missed some tiny layout mistake or sent the wrong version, and my mind just keeps going back to it anyway.
Do you feel like these thoughts about potential mistakes at work are something you'd like to have or something you wish you could stop having?

I wish I could stop having them. I don’t want to keep going back over whether there’s some tiny mistake in a layout or if I sent the wrong version. Even when it looks fine, it just… keeps coming back.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors or mental acts that you feel driven to perform outside of your work?

Not really outside of work, no. It’s mostly before I submit something… I’ll reopen the file, compare layers, save it again, and kind of mentally go through the choices one more time. It doesn’t take over my whole day, but it does slow me down.
Have you ever had to take time off work or significantly reduce your work activities because of these thoughts or checking behaviors?

I haven’t taken time off, no. I’m still getting the work done… but I have missed some internal deadlines lately. And I think I’ve been playing it safer with design choices because I’m worried I’ll miss something and it’ll hurt my chances of moving up, like toward a creative director role.
Have you noticed any significant problems in your relationships with coworkers or supervisors due to these thoughts and checking behaviors?

Not directly, no… I mean, no one’s confronted me or anything. I’m still getting the work done. But I have missed some internal deadlines, and I think I’m holding back on some bolder ideas because I’m worried I’ll miss something and it’ll hurt my chances of moving toward a creative director role.
Have you noticed any problems in your daily life outside of work, such as with hobbies or personal interests, because of these thoughts or checking behaviors?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed it affecting hobbies or anything personal… it feels pretty contained to work.
Do you think these thoughts about potential mistakes are reasonable or excessive?

I mean… I know it’s probably excessive. Like, I can look at the layout or the file and see it’s most likely fine, but then my mind keeps going back to, what if I missed some tiny mistake, or sent the wrong version. It just keeps circling.
Do you feel like these thoughts about mistakes at work are forcing you to think about them even when you're trying not to?

Yeah… I think so. Even when I’m trying to move on, I’ll get pulled back into thinking maybe I missed some tiny mistake in the layout, or maybe I sent the wrong version. I can tell myself it’s probably fine, but it keeps coming back.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors or mental acts outside of work that you feel driven to perform?
Not really… I can’t think of anything outside of work that I feel driven to repeat like that.
